name: Rosa Fiorelli Winery
description: Rosa Fiorelli Winery is a independent farm in 4250 County Road 675, FL. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
